name: The Occupant
summary:
The Occupant is a Backrooms inspired multiplayer puzzle-solving horror experience. Taking inspiration from games like Escape the Backrooms and Backrun VR, The Occupant is one of the most immersive Backrooms inspired VR games out there today.
